name: go-nil-deref
diff:
diff --git a/fetch.go b/fetch.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1111111
--- /dev/null
+++ b/fetch.go
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+package main
+
+import "net/http"
+
+func fetch(url string) string {
+	resp, err := http.Get(url)
+	_ = err
+	return resp.Status
+}

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+package main
+
+import "net/http"
+
+func fetch(url string) string {
+	resp, err := http.Get(url)
+	_ = err
+	return resp.Status
+}

defects.description: err from http.Get is discarded and resp is dereferenced; when the request fails resp can be unusable and the error is lost
